devdoc.details: Integrates with GMX V2 DataStore to fetch Chainlink price feed addresses

params._dataStore: Address of GMX DataStore contract (0xFD70de6b91282D8017aA4E741e9Ae325CAb992d8 on Arbitrum)

returns.priceFeedAddress: Address of the Chainlink price feed

returns.longTokenPriceFeed: Price feed for long collateral token
returns.shortTokenPriceFeed: Price feed for short collateral token

returns.indexToken: Address of the index token (e.g., WETH for ETH/USD market)
returns.longToken: Address of the long collateral token
returns.shortToken: Address of the short collateral token

returns.price: Current price from Chainlink (8 decimals typically)
